description: Least-privilege capability for the main window (threat-model TB2): core:default only, plus opener for official store-protocol launches + open-install-folder (TB3), and window controls for the custom (borderless) title bar — show/close/minimize/toggle-maximize/start-dragging/is-maximized. No fs/shell permissions are exposed to JS — all privileged work (spawn, registry, disk walk) stays in Rust commands.
